title: BACE: Safety & Workplace Culture - Biotechnology - Sharps Safety
subject: Biotechnology

questions.q: Regarding needle safety, which practice is strictly prohibited in the laboratory?
options: Disposing of needles in a sharps container.
Using a one-handed scoop technique if recapping is absolutely necessary.
questions.explain: Recapping needles is a primary cause of needlestick injuries. Two-handed recapping is strictly prohibited. If recapping is unavoidable, a mechanical device or the one-handed scoop method must be used.
